# WorthMore

> Free Higher or Lower money games. Guess which is worth more — countries by GDP, companies by market cap, US states, Chinese provinces and sports teams — and build the longest streak. No sign-up, plays instantly in the browser.

## Games
- World Cup Picker: /world-cup-bracket-predictor/ — tap your winner of every knockout tie to predict the 2026 World Cup champion and share your bracket.
- World Cup Player Value: Higher or Lower: /world-cup-player-value-higher-or-lower/ — guess which footballer has the higher transfer market value, across 150+ stars of the 2026 World Cup.
- National Team Value: Higher or Lower: /world-cup-team-value-higher-or-lower/ — guess which national team has the higher total squad market value.
- Which Is Worth More?: /which-is-worth-more/ — mixed pool of countries, companies, states, provinces and teams, all valued in US dollars.
- GDP Per Capita: Higher or Lower: /gdp-per-capita-higher-or-lower/ — guess which country has the higher income per person.

## Guides
- Most Valuable Players at the 2026 World Cup: /guides/most-valuable-world-cup-2026-players/
- Most Valuable National Teams at the 2026 World Cup: /guides/most-valuable-national-teams-2026/

## Notes
- All money values are approximate public-source snapshots, labelled with the year/month they are from. For entertainment only, not a financial reference.
- Football player and national team values are Transfermarkt-style estimates converted to USD. WorthMore is independent and not affiliated with FIFA, the World Cup or Transfermarkt.
